title: Meri Maa ne Mujhe
body:
meri maa ne mujhe godh may ye wird sikhaya
kaha ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
allah ne hai mujhko nauhakhwan banaya
kaha haye hussain sab ne mil ke kaha
haye hussain haye hussain haye hussain
meri maa ne mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
paida kare momin jo badi unki shaan hai
wo khush naseeb maayein hai mera emaan hai
bachon ko hai jinho ne sach ka sabaq padhaya
kaha haye hussain sab ne mil ke kaha
haye hussain haye hussain haye hussain
meri maa ne mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran ke waarison ka hua band hai pani
pamaal hui ran may hai qasim ki jawani
jab hum ne suna hai gaya qaimon ko jalaya
kaha haye hussain sab ne mil ke kaha
haye hussain haye hussain haye hussain
meri maa ne mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloom pe rona hai rada kehta hai quran
sunnat adaa karo ye agar tum ho musalman
zinda hussain ka hai nabi sog manaya
kaha haye hussain sab ne mil ke kaha
haye hussain haye hussain haye hussain
meri maa ne mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ya rab koi masooma se aaghaz e safar hai
is zikr ke sadqe may sayyeda ki nazar hai
hai paak sakina ne mera bakht jagaya
kaha haye hussain sab ne mil ke kaha
haye hussain haye hussain haye hussain
meri maa ne mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
khursheed azadaron may kohraam bapa hai
har soo buland hogayi matam ki sada hai
sadiq hasan ne nauhon may hai sab ko rulaya
kaha haye hussain sab ne mil ke kaha
haye hussain haye hussain haye hussain
meri maa ne mujhe...
author: Haider Khursheed
